external_entities.name: Customer
external_entities.description: A customer who browses and places orders through the mobile app and receives faxed confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: Marketing
external_entities.description: The marketing function that maintains the product catalogue.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application customers use to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: Web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app that stores customer data and hands orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that processes orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS does two things with an order.

processes.name: Fax gateway
processes.description: The gateway that sends dispatch notes by fax to the number stored against an order.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway, which faxes the customer a confirmation
processes.notes: Nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

processes.name: Spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the marketing catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: User database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer names, addresses, and the cards they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: Flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file kept alongside SIMS containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: Spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The marketing catalogue spreadsheet containing product prices and product copy, stored on a marketing laptop in the office.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: talks to
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: keeps customers
data_flows.description: The web API stores customer names, addresses, and payment card information in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_flows.data_description: customer name, address, and payment card

data_flows.name: hands order over
data_flows.description: The web API hands an order to SIMS when an order is placed.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: writes address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: sends dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: faxes confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes the customer a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.
data_flows.data_description: confirmation with customer name and address

data_flows.name: send SQL statements
data_flows.description: The spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: Office
trust_boundaries.description: The office network location where the marketing laptop hosting the spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app is a non-web interface because the source identifies it as a mobile app rather than a web application.
assumptions.basis: The source says customers use the mobile app.

assumptions.assumption: The fax gateway is a non-web interface because it is described as a fax gateway.
assumptions.basis: The source says the gateway faxes a confirmation.

assumptions.assumption: The spreadsheet macros run in the office zone because the spreadsheet containing them is stored on a laptop in the office.
assumptions.basis: The source says the spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The user database is confidential because it contains customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains customer name, address, and the card they paid with.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is confidential because it contains delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains delivery addresses only.
